caption: The drawing depicts a dagger-like object centered on a plain, light beige background. The object consists of a straight handle with a twisted or spiraled texture, rendered in shades of dark brown and gray. Below the handle is a short, straight cross-guard oriented horizontally, matching the handle’s earthy colors. The blade extends downward from the guard and has a rough, weathered appearance, with irregularities, pitting, and surface texture suggesting corrosion. The blade's color transitions from brown and gray nearer the guard to a slightly greenish tint towards the lower portion, which has a rounded tip rather than a sharp point. In the lower right corner of the image, a signature is visible in cursive script. There are no additional objects or background features aside from some faint spots or marks on the otherwise blank background.
title: Dirk
